text: acct-5d1e2d (mirage): diagnosis of the not-live sockets in your screenshot: it is the PHONE's sockets. With the GitHub engine doing the scanning, the phone never opens its BoltOdds, Kalshi or SX sockets (only the engine holds them), so they read 'not live', 'off, last push never' and '0 of 0 markets'; Pinnodds shows not running because you have no socket plan. So nothing is broken, but the dashboard hid what the engine's sockets are doing. Fix building now (v0.117.6, about 10 min): the engine publishes its own BoltOdds/Kalshi/SX socket state (live or not, markets, last push, games in play) and the dashboard shows those. Once the engine restarts on it I'll check each one and fix any that really isn't live (the engine's start line said Kalshi socket 'off', so I'll look at that first).
